recipes.name: Roxie's Bran Muffins
ingredients_raw: 1.5 cups bran cereal (such as Kellogg's All-Bran® Original Cereal)

steps.text: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Grease 12 muffin cups or line with paper cupcake liners.
Cover raisins with water in a microwave-safe bowl; microwave on High for 1 minute to plump. Drain raisins and set aside.

Beat egg with milk in a bowl; mix in bran cereal. Let mixture stand until cereal absorbs liquid, about 5 minutes. Gently mix in plumped raisins, flour, baking soda, cinnamon, melted butter, shredded apple, mashed banana, and honey; stir a few times to mix.
Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups. Bake in the preheated oven for about 20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a muffin comes out clean.

raw_recipe.headline: Roxie's Bran Muffins
raw_recipe.description: Bran muffins are made with bran cereal, apple, banana, honey, and plump raisins.

review.reviewBody: Very moist, not what I expected from a bran muffin. It had a light fruity taste and just the right amount of raisins. I didn't bother microwaving the raisins to make them soft, I just let them soak in the milk/egg/cereal mixture for five minutes. I used all-purpose flour as opposed to wheat and 2 Tbsp. of veg. oil instead of melted butter. I also added 2 Tbsp. of brown sugar. These made exactly 12 muffins that rose up nicely and they were done in 20 minutes - perfect!

I don’t use linners, make 6 jumbo and mix 3/4cup diced pecans, 1/3 cup brown sugar & 1 tablespoon melted buter in a small bowl…. Heavily grease bottom with butter (you can just spray sides) . Drop 1/6 mixer in each jumbo cup and top with batter. After baking, allow to set 5 min. It’s an upside down bran muffin with a pecan “pie” top!

Very good muffins! Everyone thought they smelled wonderful baking and tasted great! Note that I did make some vegan adjustments to the recipe to make them appeal to all house members. First substituted an additional 1/2 mashed banana for the egg, a mixture of all-purpose flour and ground flaxseed for the whole wheat (approx. 50/50) unsweetened almond milk, vegan butter and added 1 tsp baking powder to help it rise a little more per another persons suggestion. I will definitely make again, though may try substituting apple sauce, pears or something else for the egg for a slightly more balanced flavor.

My family loves this recipe. My only changes: a teaspoon of vanilla (I add it to the milk/egg mixture before adding the cereal), and 1/8 of a teaspoon of salt.

The cooking time is WAY too long for our oven - be careful the first time you make this! I cook them at 375'F for 14 minutes and they come out perfectly.

These muffins are so yummy and healthy!
Changes I made were that I added all liquid ingredients together first before Flour , baking soda and cinnamon.
I also used 1/2 cup wild blueberries dusted with flour in place of the raisins. Lastly because the apple and banana are so sweet I only used 1/3 cup honey.
They came out perfect. :~ )

This is my go to recipe for my kiddo's quick breakfast. I double the batch, freeze them for 15 minutes on a cookie sheet and then put them in a ziploc bag in the freezer. I microwave them for 20seconds in the morning, and voila! Breakfast is served! Great when you are running out the door! I also add a handful of chocolate chips- just a bit of incentive that they will be eaten:) delicious and hearty!

Wonderful taste. I used 2 bananas only, as I had no apples or raisins. I baked for only 15 minutes. Perfectly done. Do not use paper liners, as muffins will stick to the paper and you'll end up with 2/3 a muffin to eat.

Really good, I used applesauce instead of oil/butter, used raisin bran instead of allbran, let it soak in the milk. Used more cinnamon. 1/2 white flour and 1/2 whole wheat pastry flour. Used less honey and rest was splenda for baking. Made a very moist, dense muffin. Could have used nuts. Loved the many textures. Could use many different bran cereals and would be good (special K strawberry, etc). Made double batch with 22 muffins, was perfectly done at 16 min convection 385.

These were great. I needed to use up some ripe bananas, so I used two of those and no apples. I also added 1 tsp vanilla and 1/2 tsp salt. These are going to become a staple! Oh, I also skipped the raisins because I have a hater in the family. But I know I would LOVE the addition of raisins. Next time.

These are a staple in my fridge. I have one for breakfast almost every morning. I’ve made a few adjustments over the years just for my taste preferences. I use dried cranberries instead of raisins, I substitute 2 tbsps applesauce for the butter and I add 1/2-1 cup of chopped walnuts. The recipe is great just as written as well.
Added 1/2 cup chopped, roasted pecans and 1 tsp vanilla and used brown sugar instead of honey.

These muffins are delicious and seem relatively healthful, if not low calorie. My banana wasn’t super ripe, but they turned out plenty sweet enough. (I used half maple syrup and half honey because I didn’t have enough honey.) Great “traditional bran muffin” flavor and texture, and very easy to make!
These are fantastic !
I added a tsp of vanilla and a T of brown sugar.

Delicious muffins. I didn't add raisins, and added little less honey. The second batch I added slivered almonds and 1/8 tsp almond extract. The original recipe will be my base and I will continue to try other fruits, berries and nuts.
Delicious
Great recipe! So moist and delicious. I substituted 2 ingredients because I was out - pumpkin pie spice for the cinnamon and AP flour for the whole wheat.
Doubled recipe, added walnuts, substituted molasses for honey, finely chopped apples instead of shredding and added vanilla. Stupid delicious!!!!!

You cannot go wrong with this recipe! Thank you! Ps. I make it with olive oil instead of butter sometimes & brown sugar instead of honey. It always works out. & Sometimes blueberries instead of raisins & sometimes I add a half cup of walnuts. This makes breakfast easy & healthy. Everyone who has ever tasted them loves them!
Added fresh blueberries instead of raisins. Fabulous!
